text.text: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
He put upon him perfect glory; and strengthened him with rich garments, with breeches, with a long robe, and the ephod.
